questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Heat or Badgers?
At which ground did Megan-Lee Mans record their career-best innings (27*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2022/10/09.

questions.question: Knights set a database record (22/23 season, T20) with a value of 104. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Biggest Win by Runs', held by Knights.

questions.question: Marizanne Kapp became the all-time leading wicket-taker in Women's ODI World Cup history in 2025, surpassing which bowler's long-standing record of 43?
questions.explanation: Kapp took her 44th World Cup wicket during South Africa's 2025 semi-final win over England, surpassing India's Jhulan Goswami.

questions.question: Who topped the wickets charts in the 24/25 season (List A)?
At Willowmoore Park Main Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Adele van Eck holds it with 17.
